name: RAG Grounding Check
description: Verify RAG-generated answers are actually grounded in their retrieved source chunks -- rag_eval's sibling for generation faithfulness rather than retrieval quality. Deterministic n-gram overlap + fabricated-number detection by default (free, no API key), with an opt-in mode='llm_judge' for nuanced cases. Attached asset check fails on regression vs the prior materialization, mirroring rag_eval.

inputs.description: Query/answer/sources rows, either from an upstream asset (upstream_asset_key) or a direct SQL query (source) -- e.g. rag_pipeline's generate-step output.

outputs.description: Upstream rows with grounding_score, grounded, fabricated_numbers (and judge_reasoning for mode='llm_judge') columns added.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame of query/answer/sources rows (e.g. rag_pipeline's output). Mutually exclusive with `source` -- set exactly one.

source.label: Source
source.description: Pull rows directly via SQL instead of from an upstream asset: {kind: warehouse_query, resource_key: <registered resource>, sql: <query>}. Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key` -- set exactly one.

answer_column.label: Answer Column
answer_column.description: Column containing the generated answer to check.

sources_column.label: Sources Column
sources_column.description: Column containing the retrieved source chunks the answer should be grounded in -- a list of {text: ...} dicts (rag_pipeline's native shape), a list of strings, or a single pre-joined string.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: 'overlap' (default): deterministic n-gram overlap + fabricated-number check -- free, no API key. 'llm_judge': any litellm-supported model judges groundedness -- costs money per row, catches paraphrased claims overlap scoring can't.

ngram_size.label: N-gram Size
ngram_size.description: N-gram size for mode='overlap' scoring (default: trigrams).

per_row_grounded_threshold.label: Per-Row Grounded Threshold
per_row_grounded_threshold.description: Per-row grounding_score at or above this is marked grounded=True in the output column.

llm_api_key_env_var.label: LLM API Key Env Var
llm_api_key_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the API key for mode='llm_judge'.

llm_max_retries.label: LLM Max Retries
llm_max_retries.description: Retries on transient LLM failures for mode='llm_judge'.

llm_prompt_prefix.label: LLM Prompt Prefix
llm_prompt_prefix.description: Optional text prepended to every mode='llm_judge' prompt (e.g. domain context).

min_grounding_score_threshold.label: Min Grounding Score Threshold
min_grounding_score_threshold.description: Absolute minimum mean grounding_score across the batch. Asset check fails below this.

regression_pct_threshold.label: Regression Pct Threshold
regression_pct_threshold.description: Max allowed drop (percentage points) in mean grounding_score vs the immediately-prior materialization. Mirrors rag_eval's regression check.

max_fabrication_rate.label: Max Fabrication Rate
max_fabrication_rate.description: If set, asset check fails when the fraction of rows with at least one fabricated number exceeds this (0.0-1.0). None (default) skips this check.

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners -- list of team names or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags to apply to the asset.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog. Auto-inferred if unset.

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata.

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when include_preview_metadata is True.

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date (ISO), required for time-based types.
